title: review-tool-probe
description: The commands of a sub agent. Each answers one line of JSON and exits with 0 for an answer and 1 for a failure.

instructions.description: instructions <probe>: answers the instructions of the probe.

items.description: What the sub agent was handed for its part of the review

ack.description: ack <probe> <acknowledgement>: acknowledges the instructions and answers the progress, or answers more detailed instructions when the acknowledgement is not the one asked for.

items.description: What the sub agent was handed for its part of the review
The phrase the instructions ask for

rules.description: rules <probe>: answers the rules of the probe.

items.description: What the sub agent was handed for its part of the review

define.description: define <probe> <term>: answers the definition of the term.

items.description: What the sub agent was handed for its part of the review

next.description: next <probe>: answers the next page of the surface.

items.description: What the sub agent was handed for its part of the review

prev.description: prev <probe>: answers the previous page of the surface.

items.description: What the sub agent was handed for its part of the review

report.description: report <probe> <rule>: records that the rule is judged and answers the rules still to judge.
